fusions.name: Stampede Line
fusions.desc: Sends a rush of force 5 tiles ahead that deals 30 blunt damage to everything in it. If it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Headlong Butt
fusions.desc: Lowers your head and butts an enemy for 13 blunt damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Grazing Ground
fusions.desc: Marks out grazing ground within 3.5 tiles of where you stand for 10 seconds. You and your allies inside it regain 3 health a second.

fusions.name: Safety in Numbers
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
